verdict.rationale: Capacities documents a Full Export in Settings, including automated scheduled full exports. The export is described as human- and machine-readable, with properties converted to front matter and collections stored as CSV, which fits open, portable formats. The REST API also provides programmatic access to content. Missing for 10: explicit confirmation that notes export as Markdown (only implied by front matter), evidence on how media/attachments and inter-object links survive export, and independent or hands-on corroboration of a complete export.
